Lakers 106Kings 104

Grimes' late three holds off Sacramento

Final · Fri, Nov 20 · Los Angeles

The Lakers trailed by 11 in the third quarter, went ahead on Quentin Grimes’ three with 56 seconds left and held on by 2.
